comment: A theme kept in custom properties and read by color functions (hsl(var(--x)), hsl(var(--x) / 0.6), rgba(var(--rgb), 0.25), rgb(var(--rgb)), color-mix() with a var() operand) in backgrounds, borders, box-shadow, outline and a gradient; switching the app to the dark theme with a class (on a wrapper: the <html> element takes classes from Lua only as the document was loaded, see the guide) changes every color at runtime.
